scenarios.description: The Index’s level is 3.14159, and it is rounded so that the displayed level has exactly two decimal places.
The Index’s level is shown with three decimal places, such as 3.142.
A different index object, not TheIndex, has a level that is rounded to two decimal places.
The Index’s level is not rounded at all until after it is used in a calculation, and only later is it rounded to two decimal places.
scenarios.drift_explanation: The source only states that the level will be rounded to two decimal places, without specifying timing or actor responsibility. The IR only constrains that if a value is the level of TheIndex, it is rounded to TwoDecimalPlaces, but it does not state when rounding occurs.
